title: At this wonderfully terrible stage of my game
author: EchoingAngel
selftext:
My dad and girlfriend were kind enough to play through the first hour of my game! It only took them 2-3 hours each :')

On the bright side, I learned a huge amount and am very grateful they put up with the tutorial that was definitely not enough for non-factory gamers.

comments.author: affabledrunk
comments.body: Great linked video. I feel you bro.

replies.author: AlgaeNo3373
replies.body: It captures game design hell pretty perfectly ngl

comments.author: Eisenkopf69
comments.body: I love this video, that poor girl must still be traumatized.

comments.author: Original-League-6094
comments.body: This is every stealth game and the player either combat or just running past. I wonder how Kojima or the Dishonored devs felt after spending months painstakingly designing careful crafted levels with multiple routes, emergent gameplay opportunities, and choreographed patrols, only to watch tons of players just sprint past everyone.

replies.author: SpookyRockjaw
replies.body: Haha, I'm dealing with this right now. Stealth is satisfying but it's far too easy to just assassinate everyone and then stroll through the level. And it kind of breaks the fantasy of placing wiretaps and photographing intelligence if you also murdered everyone in the building. But I want lethal force to be an option... Arghh 🤦

replies.author: Original-League-6094
replies.body: Yeah. The easy solution is to just add scoring after a mission to visible shame the player for killing everyone. Yes, you can kill everyone and get spotted 100 times, but damn it, we are going to remind you of your lack of skills at the end.

replies.author: SpookyRockjaw
replies.body: Yeah, I have a rating system and hopefully that dangles the carrot for people who want to earn full stars. I've also introduced reinfocements that show up if you cause too much chaos. But it's that classic hammer and nail thing. Give a person a gun and everything looks like a target. Immersive sim's struggle for the same reason. They are trying to do so much more but, on first glance, they resemble an fps. A certain percentage of players is just gonna go in blasting.
